name: mirage
text:
Done on the engine side, started now; the by-hand block is not built yet.
Engine changes (live in the config, logged with a revert line):
- Dropped NCAAB and NCAAF from the scan. NCAAB was -5.1% over 1,570 bets and NCAAF -2.2%.
- Bids now go only on player props and team totals. Game-line bids almost never fill, and team totals beat the closing line best.
- Turned on the 'more, smaller bids' switch (many 1/16-Kelly bids, best types first, same EV rules).
- Auto-bet was already limited to props, moneylines and team totals since 11-15. Engine is switched on.
One thing I can't fix: your wallet cash is about $0.01 ($200 sits in open bets), so the engine can't place anything until money is back in the subaccount. Moving money is yours to do.
By hand: you said to block bets that have lost with large samples. Today the app only warns. I'm adding a hard block in the Bet sheet for types that lose with at least 300 bets and a clear margin: player prop overs, NCAAB and game totals first. It needs an app release; I'll tell you when it's out.
